response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), city_stats AS (
  SELECT
    city_id,
    address_count,
    AVG(address_count) OVER () AS avg_addresses_per_city,
    SUM(address_count) OVER () AS total_addresses
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT
  city_id,
  address_count,
  address_count / avg_addresses_per_city AS count_over_city_average,
  address_count / total_addresses AS share_of_addresses
FROM city_stats
ORDER BY share_of_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is across city IDs represented in address, matching the requested groups; ties at the cutoff may be returned in any order.

alternatives.interpretation: If the average should include every city in city, including cities with no addresses, use this query; the output still includes only city IDs represented in address.
alternatives.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), city_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cc.city_id,
    cc.address_count,
    (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(ac.address_count, 0))
     FROM city c
     LEFT JOIN (
       SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
       FROM address
       GROUP BY city_id
     ) ac ON ac.city_id = c.city_id) AS avg_addresses_per_city,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS total_addresses
  FROM city_counts cc
)
SELECT
  city_id,
  address_count,
  address_count / avg_addresses_per_city AS count_over_city_average,
  address_count / total_addresses AS share_of_addresses
FROM city_stats
ORDER BY share_of_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;
